product_one_liner.value: Paddle is a merchant-of-record payments and billing platform that handles checkout, subscriptions, global tax compliance, fraud protection and retention for SaaS, mobile app, AI and digital product companies.

pricing_page.notes: Publishes pay-as-you-go pricing of 5% + 50¢ per checkout transaction.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in customer success stories.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying posts cover Paddle's Go microservices and payment-routing rules engine; both are authored by George Wilson, Head of Engineering, Payments.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation includes product explanations, quickstarts and integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open Head of Data Science posting with an application link.

model_provider.notes: Paddle explicitly describes its documentation assistant as Kapa.ai-powered; the underlying foundation model is not disclosed.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2, GDPR and PCI DSS 4.0.1; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest identified financing: the accounts disclosure reports a 29 May 2026 convertible loan note instrument and US$25 million of unsecured notes issued in four tranches to existing institutional shareholders.

raised_18mo.notes: The disclosed US$25 million convertible-note financing in May 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Business Development Representative posting for the UK.

launched_6mo.notes: Announced the Paddle AI Toolkit on 20 October 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The executive team page lists current leaders but does not provide start dates; no qualifying appointment or departure could be verified for the requested 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named in the Senior Lifecycle Marketing Specialist job description.
